title: Is this Girl for Real?!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Riding his bike late at night, Jun finds a drunk, half-naked young woman by the road and takes her home to sleep it off. She turns out to be Narumi Kawase, the new assistant to his author mother, who has no idea how to do her job, so Jun must coach her while coping with her habit of getting drunk, stripping and becoming cuddly. An eight-volume seinen ecchi romantic comedy.
life_message: Patience and decency toward a messy, struggling person can grow into affection.
